meaning:
Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז),
Boaz (Rut.2:1): Mat.1:5, Luk.3:32.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Booz

elsewhere.note: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
